name: Warp-Level Culling for Efficient Blending in 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: An optimization for the 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) alpha blending stage that uses warp-level collaboration to subdivide image tiles and cull splats with no geometric overlap, avoiding expensive alpha evaluation.
summary: Warp-Level Culling optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting by using warp-level collaboration to cull splats with no geometric overlap, reducing blending operations and improving speed without altering output.
